# sonatypeiq_config_reverse_proxy_authentication (Resource)

Manage Reverse Proxy Authentication configuration for IQ Server

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create and manage Reverse Proxy Authentication Configuration for Sonatype IQ Server
#
# WARNING: Enabling reverse proxy authentication changes how users sign in to IQ Server.
# When enabled, users authenticate via a reverse proxy that provides the username in an
# HTTP header. This may affect the account Terraform itself connects as if using the
# same authentication mechanism. Test thoroughly in a non-production environment before
# enabling in production.
#
# Note: For safety, this example shows the configuration as disabled (enabled = false).
# You can prepare the configuration without activating it.
resource "sonatypeiq_config_reverse_proxy_authentication" "reverse_proxy_auth" {
  enabled                  = false                            # Set to true to enable reverse proxy authentication
  username_header          = "X-Forwarded-User"               # The header containing the username (defaults to REMOTE_USER)
  csrf_protection_disabled = false                            # WARNING: Setting to true disables CSRF protection - only use for legacy client compatibility
  logout_url               = "https://sso.example.com/logout" # Optional: URL to redirect to on logout
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether reverse proxy authentication is enabled. When enabled, users authenticate via a reverse proxy that provides the username in an HTTP header. This changes how users sign in and may affect the account Terraform itself connects as - ensure you understand the implications before enabling.

### Optional

- `csrf_protection_disabled` (Boolean) Whether Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection is disabled. Used for backward compatibility with old client plugins. Disabling CSRF protection is a security risk - only set this to true if absolutely necessary for compatibility with legacy clients.
- `logout_url` (String) The redirect URL when a user logs out. Leave unset to prevent redirection on logout.
- `username_header` (String) The name of the HTTP request header that contains the username. When not set, defaults to 'REMOTE_USER' on the server.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID for Terraform State
- `last_updated` (String) String representation of the date/time the resource was last changed

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# System Reverse Proxy Authentication Configuration can be imported.

# Example
terraform import sonatypeiq_config_reverse_proxy_authentication.config system-reverse-proxy-authentication-configuration
```
